postconditions.description: The number of output sequences is equal to the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i]) == n for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output sequence has the same length as the input sequences.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][j] in {a[j], b[j], c[j]} for i in range(t) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output sequence is one of the corresponding elements from the input sequences.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i][j] != output[i][(j+1)%n] for i in range(t) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent elements in the output sequence are equal.
